info.description: Unified Underwater Marine Debris Benchmark Dataset (SeaClear + TrashCan 1.0)
source_datasets: SeaClear Marine Debris Dataset (TU Delft / University of Dubrovnik, 2022)

categories.name: fishing_net
categories.description: Submerged fishing nets, ghost nets, gillnets, trawl fragments, and netting debris.

categories.name: rope_line
categories.description: Synthetic or natural fiber ropes, mooring lines, buoy lines, and cordage debris.

categories.name: debris_bag
categories.description: Plastic bags, shopping bags, trash bags.

categories.name: debris_container
categories.description: Plastic and metal buckets, drums, food containers, jugs.

categories.name: debris_pipe
categories.description: Rigid plastic or metal pipes, conduits.

categories.name: debris_snack_wrapper
categories.description: Plastic and paper snack wrappers, chip packets, candy wrappers.

categories.name: debris_tarp
categories.description: Plastic sheets, tarpaulins, plastic foil covers.

categories.name: debris_wreckage
categories.description: Submerged vessel wreckage, scrap metal structures.

categories.name: debris_branch_wood
categories.description: Submerged tree branches, natural processed wood fragments.

categories.name: debris_other
categories.description: Unclassified debris, rubber tires, footwear, cement tubes, bricks, glass jars, sanitary debris.

categories.name: uncertain_cable_metal
categories.description: Heavy industrial metal cables/wires. Ambiguous: may be maritime infrastructure, mooring line, or abandoned trawl warp. Excluded from rope/net to prevent semantic distortion.

categories.name: rov_equipment
categories.description: ROV chassis, thrusters, camera arms, umbilical cables, survey markers. NOT environmental debris.

categories.name: marine_biology
categories.description: Marine organisms (fish, urchins, crabs, eels, sponges, shells, starfish, sea plants). Preserved for false-positive reduction.
